entities.summary: Alexander Mikhailovich Krasnoshchyokov, real name Avraam Moiseyevich Krasnoshchyok, was a Soviet politician and the first leader of the Far Eastern Republic. On November 25, 1937, he was sentenced to death by the Military Collegium of the Supreme Court of the USSR.
